what: Reference-engine step semantics make CYCLE reachable through the explicit toggles relation.
before: The engine transition was monotonic, so no initial state could return to a previously observed state after changing.
after: An active toggle source alternates its target between active and inactive; EXP-002 observes bounded CYCLE runs while existing relation semantics remain unchanged.
semantic_impact: adds one explicit experimental relation and preserves requires, excludes, and couples behavior
